title: Two Orders and Decorations
description: 1. An Order of Civil Accomplishment, by Spink & Son of London - A large medal constructed of gilded bronze and multi-coloured enamels, consisting of a hexagonal award with a central white enameled hexagonal medallion bearing writing in Arabic, with a semi-circular shape bearing green enameled and gilt outward-pointing lines in the background, suspended from a polished medallion bearing a Emblem of the country from its period original sewn-on ribbon, measuring 96.3 mm (w) x 96.2 mm (l), extremely fine. 2. An Order of Political Accomplishment - Unmarked however also likely to be of Enlgish manufacture, in silver with black enamles, featuring a large centre gilt disc adorned by national colours, measuring 10 cm x 12 cm (h - inclusive of suspension with bar), extremely fine.
notes: Civil Accomplishment and Political Accomplishment are existing families; each complete object was cropped from the shared front and reverse group photographs while originals were preserved.
